notes.title: Bugfixes Patch v 0.1.4
notes.notes:
[b]Thank you for your feedback![/b]
We're actively working to improve the game and fix all reported bugs.

[h2]🛠 Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]✅ Checkpoint Fixes[/h3][list]  [*][b]Checkpoint 1:[/b]    [list]      [*]Therapist location resets properly[/*]      [*]Room lighting issues fixed[/*]      [*]Dialogue can now be skipped; door unlocks instantly[/*]      [*]Door closes correctly again[/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*][b]Checkpoint 2:[/b]    [list]      [*]Figures reset properly[/*]      [*]Cleaning assistant returns to default location[/*]      [*]Chest resets as expected[/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*][b]Checkpoint 3:[/b]    [list]      [*]Player position resets correctly[/*]      [*]Minigame resets properly[/*]    [/list]  [/*][/list]
[h3]📘 General Improvements[/h3][list]  [*]Added tutorials[/*]  [*]Improved overall performance[/*]  [*]Increased cassette volume[/*][/list]
[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3][list]  [*]Fixed issue where player became invisible while attacking[/*]  [*]Fixed bug where locked doors opened when clicked rapidly[/*]  [*]Fixed flashlight not working[/*]  [*]Fixed item interaction in the introduction[/*]  [*]Fixed issue where player was visible outside the intended area[/*]  [*]Fixed wall clipping while attacking[/*]  [*]Added kitchen key directly to inventory[/*][/list]
If you encounter any other bugs, please let us know here or via your preferred channel.
We’ll do our best to address them as quickly as possible!
